apartment-2025.name: Apartment — completed interior
apartment-2025.title: Finished apartment in Kyiv — 360° 3D tour | CAS Development
apartment-2025.description: 360° 3D tour of a finished apartment in Kyiv: living room, kitchen, bedroom, entrance hall and bathroom. See the finishes, furniture and lighting as if inside.
apartment-2025.lead: A 360° tour of a finished apartment in Kyiv: the interior after the works were completed, shot with a 360 camera. Walk through the rooms and look at the finishes, furniture and lighting the way you would on a site visit.
p: This is a completed project, not a visualisation: the photos show real walls, joints, plumbing and lighting. That is how a renovation should be judged — by the result, not by a render.

CAS renovates apartments with its own team: [turnkey renovation in Kyiv](/en/turnkey-renovation) — from $550/m² (labour and rough materials; finishing materials, furniture and appliances are separate, per estimate). During the works the client gets photo reports every 1–2 weeks, and a 24/7 online camera on site can be added for an extra fee. If there is no design yet, we start with [apartment interior design](/en/apartment-interior-design). More projects are in the [portfolio](/en/portfolio).

edelweiss.name: Edelweiss — 108 m² apartment design project
edelweiss.title: Edelweiss, 108 m² apartment — 360° 3D tour | CAS Development
edelweiss.description: 360° 3D tour of the Edelweiss apartment design project, 108 m²: hall, living room with kitchen, bedrooms, walk-in wardrobe, bathrooms. Walk it before works.
edelweiss.lead: 360 visualisations of the Edelweiss apartment design project, 108 m²: a light interior with soft textures, a walk-in wardrobe and graphic art. This is a 3D model of the project, not photos of a finished apartment.
p: The kitchen is combined with the living and dining area in one space, the walls behind the beds are finished with textile panels, and the walk-in wardrobe has glass fronts. The brief, solution and photos are on the [Edelweiss project page](/en/proekty/edelweiss).
edelweiss.tail: [Apartment interior design](/en/apartment-interior-design) — from $30/m², minimum order $2,500. CAS can carry out a project like this in full: [turnkey renovation](/en/turnkey-renovation) — from $550/m². Other work is in the [portfolio](/en/portfolio).

hoda-estate.name: Hoda Estate — house design project in the Carpathians
hoda-estate.title: Hoda Estate, Carpathian house — 360° 3D tour | CAS
hoda-estate.description: 360° 3D tour of the Hoda Estate house design project, 180 m², in the Carpathians: living room with kitchen, bedrooms, stone bathrooms, a bathhouse.
hoda-estate.lead: 360 visualisations of the interior design project for the Hoda Estate house, 180 m², in the Carpathians: wood, stone, linen and mountain views from the main rooms. This is a 3D model of the project, not photos of a built house.
p: Exposed timber beams under the ceiling, light plaster, panoramic windows facing the mountains. The kitchen, living room and dining area form one space, natural stone is used in the bathrooms, and there is a separate bathhouse and laundry. The brief and solution are on the [Hoda Estate project page](/en/proekty/hoda-estate).
hoda-estate.tail: [House interior design](/en/house-design) — from $30/m², minimum $2,500. CAS takes on renovation and construction in all regions of Ukraine, so a project in the Carpathians can be taken through to completion: [house construction](/en/house-construction) — from $600/m², turnkey from $1,100/m². More work is in the [portfolio](/en/portfolio).

triangle-house.name: Triangle House — interior concept
triangle-house.title: Triangle House — 3D tour of an interior concept | CAS
triangle-house.description: 360° 3D tour of the Triangle House interior concept: a two-storey hall, living room with kitchen, bedrooms and a bathroom. Walk through the concept online.
triangle-house.lead: 360 visualisations of the interior concept for Triangle House: living room with kitchen, bedrooms, a bathroom and a hall on two floors. A concept is an interior option in 3D, not photos of a built house.
p: In the tour you can go from the ground-floor hall to the upper hall and look into the bedrooms and bathroom — you can see how the house is organised vertically.
triangle-house.tail: [House interior design](/en/house-design) — from $30/m², minimum $2,500. We can also build the house: [house construction](/en/house-construction) — from $600/m², turnkey from $1,100/m², and our specialists do the site survey and aerial photography. More projects are in the [portfolio](/en/portfolio).

yablunytsia-estate.name: Estate in Yablunytsia — concept
yablunytsia-estate.title: Estate in Yablunytsia, Carpathians — 360° 3D tour | CAS
yablunytsia-estate.description: 360° 3D tour of the concept for an estate in Yablunytsia (Carpathians): grounds, pool, houses and paths. See how the estate looks together with its landscape.
yablunytsia-estate.lead: 360 visualisations of the concept for an estate in Yablunytsia (Carpathians): the grounds, a pool, houses and the paths between them. This is a 3D model of the concept, not photos of a built estate.
p: The viewpoints are spread across the grounds: you can see how the houses sit relative to the pool, where the paths lead and how the estate looks as a whole. For a country property this works better than separate renders — the plot, the houses and the landscape are seen together.
For a real plot our specialists do the land survey and aerial photography, so the project is based on the actual terrain.
yablunytsia-estate.tail: [Landscape design](/en/landscape-design) — from $50 per 100 m²; [house construction](/en/house-construction) — from $600/m², turnkey from $1,100/m². If the estate is meant as a place for guests to stay, see [turnkey holiday resort](/en/resort-design). More work is in the [portfolio](/en/portfolio).

apartment-45.title: 45 m² apartment — 360° design project tour | CAS
apartment-45.description: 360° 3D tour of a 45 m² apartment design project: hall, kitchen, living room, bedroom and bathroom. Judge the proportions of a small flat before renovation.

apartment-37.title: 37 m² apartment — 360° design project tour | CAS
apartment-37.description: 360° 3D tour of a compact 37 m² apartment design project: hall, kitchen, living room, bedroom and bathroom. See how everything fits into this area.
apartment-37.lead: 360 visualisations of the design project for a 37 m² apartment: hall, kitchen, living room, bedroom and bathroom. This is a 3D model of the project, not photos of a finished apartment.
